messages:
Maya (Design): quick mock up here https://rwd/fig/trace-legend-v3.png — can people scan for the legend ordering and the 'Copy correlation id' affordance? thinking: inline copy button vs overflow menu + make Export more prominent for files
Felipe (Product): lean toward inline copy — most support flows are copy-paste. Export for bulk downloads. inline copy saves one click for SOC2 ops folks
Arjun (Eng-runtime): +1 inline but needs clear a11y label: use `aria-label=\"Copy correlation ID to clipboard\"`. make it keyboard-focusable and small. show toast on success: 'Copied trace id' not just icon flip.
Sam (Eng-platform): UI noise concern — if we keep copy + export visible we should group actions under a compact "Actions" menu on narrow widths. power users will grumble about extra click though
Lina (Accessibility): quick a11y checks: current light-grey legend text fails contrast for small captions (ratio < 3:1). suggestions: increase to 4.5:1 for labels or bump font-weight. screen-reader: read correlation id as one token — set `aria-label=\"Correlation ID: <id>\"` and role=\"button\" on copy control
Maya (Design): noted re contrast. also the legend order feels off — users expect error-first context. current is [Warnings, Errors, Latency]. propose [Errors, Requests, Duration] so the red severity is first and duration last
Felipe (Product): that order makes sense for dashboards where troubleshooting is primary. ok on product side. also request drilldown export: CSV headers need standardization — please include `trace_id,span_id,timestamp,duration_ms,service` as canonical order
Arjun (Eng-runtime): CSV is fine but we should offer JSONL too for fidelity (stack traces + tags). and ensure exported stack frames redact obvious PII by default (emails, ip-like strings) with a toggle for full export behind perms
Maya (Design): UX wording tweak: primary CTA when sharing a permalink should read 'Share' not 'Export' — keep 'Export' for downloads. change inline button label from 'Copy' -> 'Copy trace ID' for clarity
Sam (Eng-platform): I'll add telemetry to measure "copy trace id" click rate. if >30% keep inline, otherwise collapse into overflow. also will check keyboard shortcut conflicts before adding a global 'c' binding
Lina (Accessibility): keyboard notes: ensure visible focus ring and a sensible tab order. for the toast use `role=\"status\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"` so screen readers announce success. avoid relying solely on color change to indicate copied state
Arjun (Eng-runtime): will prototype the a11y props and unit tests. also add e2e to assert `aria-label` exists and toast is announced. for export endpoints I'll add `format=jsonl` + `format=csv` options
Maya (Design): thanks everyone — I'll update the mock and push a revised frame. pinging @Felipe for final sign-off when I post the new art. :thumbsup:
TraceBot: Deploy preview available at https://rwd/deploys/trace-legend-v3 — preview expires in 3 days
